name: Kineticist
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Low to moderate Perception; high Nature, moderate Athletics; high Con; moderate AC; high to extreme Fortitude, high Reflex, low Will; moderate HP; high accuracy with blasts and low to moderate damage; extreme spell DC (standing in for class DC). Abilities: Two-action Elemental Blast (use Strikes for one-action Elemental Blast, bludgeoning or cold damage, 30 feet), Channel Elements, its blasts can move a creature 5 to 10 feet, Water impulse feats. Junctions: pick one, maybe two, of the element's gate junctions (impulse, aura, critical blast, elemental resistance, skill) for the stat block rather than stacking them all; more is a GM's option for a tougher kineticist

notes.defense: Moderate AC; high to extreme Fortitude, high Reflex, low Will; moderate HP.
notes.offense: High attack bonus with blasts (its spell attack) and low to moderate damage.
notes.spells: Extreme spell DC, standing in for its class DC: its impulses work like spells, but it has no spellcasting.
notes.specials: Two-action Elemental Blast (use Strikes for the one-action Elemental Blast, bludgeoning or cold damage, 30 feet), Channel Elements; its blasts can move a creature 5 to 10 feet; Water impulse feats.
